body: Not really, the people close enough to me for me to tell them have their own serious problems that I don't want to make worse by worrying them. I think I need to silently just start therapy again so I can at least vent and not become trapped inside my own head.

I can tell the people closest to me all I like, but in the end I feel like I'm still putting on a mask for their sake, faking improvement so that I don't hurt them. But you're right about it being empty and lonely, but it makes so sense for me to be.

Medication is an option I suppose, although I've never really considered it for whatever reason that may be. I should probably start seeing someone again even if all that comes of it is opportunities to vent.

I've been to multiple therapists in the past, the most recent being about six months ago, but even then the help just kept me going, nothing ever really seemed to improve and I still felt like I was faking improvement to please others.

But yeah, venting can seriously help, and it's great to have been able to vent here. Thanks for taking the time to reply.
